items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of beach bonfire permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026, sent by ordinary post. Under § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG (as cited in the letter) it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting = Sun 22.11.2026; this day does not shift for deemed-delivery purposes. The one-month Widerspruch period starts the following day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later, on the day with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Tue 22.12.2026. That day is a business day in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: The letterhead lists an IBAN (DE74 2169 0000 0001 8004 00); the IBAN itself is well-formed (Landesmusterbank, BLZ 21690000), but this letter does not demand any payment, so there is no need to use it — do not pay anything in connection with this letter unless a separate, verified invoice asks for it.
